title: What Gives the Answer Away? Question Answering Bias Analysis on Video QA Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a text-only pretrained language model (RoBERTa) on multimodal Video QA datasets to measure what percentage of questions can be answered correctly using only the question and answer text, entirely bypassing the visual/video context.

Constructing an inter-annotator accuracy shift confusion matrix and comparing model performance on dataset re-splits that have overlapping versus non-overlapping annotators across the training and validation sets.

Ablating and comparing text-only model accuracy based on question prefixes to determine if abstract/reasoning questions (e.g., 'why', 'how') contain more exploitable textual biases than factual/direct questions (e.g., 'what', 'who', 'where').
